decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - The basement rooms have substandard natural light and do not qaulify as habitable rooms.  The basement is only suitable for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse known as 77 Airedale Avenue, W4 2NN.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 2pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Alterations to existing basement to create playroom, utility storage and formation of a lightwell to the front elevation of existing dwellinghouse.
